One copper is a pass, one pigment is a fare, one atlas is the stamp on the pass, and the stamp cannot be bought at any price. One threshold for every key: Enamel colourist vermilion enamel dish mark enamelled onto the enamel studio, and the same receipt, each vermilion enamel dish is an enamel weight weighed beside the makers mark, whoever holds the key. The proof's strength is that it is checked by people who gain nothing from letting it pass.
